## Change

Describe the user or maintainer impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `bash scripts/public_validation.sh` or the relevant focused checks pass.
- [ ] New backend behavior has tests.
- [ ] New user-facing behavior has browser coverage when applicable.

## Safety and operations

- [ ] No credentials, customer data, browser state, or live private values are included.
- [ ] Data flow, retention, migration, or rollback impact is documented.
- [ ] The OpenAPI contract and release notes are updated when needed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes follow `SECURITY.md`.
